title: Laser directed energy deposited Al0.8Nb0.5Ti2V2Zr0.5 lightweight refractory high entropy alloy: Regionalization of microstructure characteristics and strengthening mechanisms
process_description: prepared by laser directed energy deposition (LDED) using pre-alloyed powder under an argon atmosphere with oxygen content below 100 ppm. Process parameters: laser power of 1200 W, layer thickness of 600 μm, scanning speed of 10 mm/s, and scanning spacing of 1500 μm.
